correctness.rationale: The Bier deleted join is a combinatorial PL (N−2)-sphere. The binary color level exactly equals the product deleted-cell complex; the red graph is induced/full and its upper half is a PL regular neighborhood. This regular neighborhood is an oriented (N−2)-dimensional 0–1 handlebody, reduced along a spanning tree to g=e−N+1 1-handles. Its boundary is the stated connected sum for every N>=5. Dimensions, empty/ghost boundaries and specialization to p=1 are explicitly checked. The standalone signed chain checker passes 12 cases (two primes; N=5,6; path/cycle/complete); no infinite inference depends on finite runs.

value.rationale: A natural infinite graph-equator family receives a complete PL-homeomorphism classification using the graph cycle rank, detecting contractible-tree sphere, cycle product and arbitrary genus. The complete graph case settles all p=1, q>=3 cases of an expressly stated November 2026 open mixed-skeleton homotopy conjecture, and does so in the stronger PL sense. This is structural and more than a finite coefficient recomputation; the all-graph result is not entailed by a known dimension/Betti calculation.
